scripts.script:
local Sprinting = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Systems.Character.Game.Sprinting)

local oldInit = Sprinting.Init
Sprinting.Init = function(...)
    local res = oldInit(...)
    Sprinting.StaminaLossDisabled = true
    return res
end

Sprinting.StaminaLossDisabled = true

local NoliConfig = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Assets.Killers.Noli.Config)

    _G.VoidRushInitialTurnDur = NoliConfig.VoidRushInitialTurnDuration
    _G.VoidRushInitialTurnMult = NoliConfig.VoidRushInitialTurnMult
    _G.VoidRushVarsSetup = true
end

for _, v in getgc(true) do
    if type(v) == "table" and rawget(v, "VoidRushInitialTurnDuration") then
        if _G.VoidRushController then
            rawset(v, "VoidRushInitialTurnDuration", 9999)
            rawset(v, "VoidRushInitialTurnMult", 9999)
        else
            rawset(v, "VoidRushInitialTurnDuration", _G.VoidRushInitialTurnDur)
            rawset(v, "VoidRushInitialTurnMult", _G.VoidRushInitialTurnMult)
        end
    end
end

pcall(function()
    game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "Void Rush Controller",
        Text = _G.VoidRushController and "Enabled\nRun the script again to disable" or "Disabled",

scripts.title: Loop tp script created by catsaken team
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local targetNames = {
    "BloxyCola",
    "Medkit"
}

local function isValidItem(obj)
    if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj.Anchored then
        for _, name in ipairs(targetNames) do
            if obj.Name:lower():find(name:lower()) then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local itemsToTarget = {}
for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if isValidItem(obj) then
        table.insert(itemsToTarget, obj)
    end
end

if #itemsToTarget > 0 then
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local activeItems = {}

    for _, item in ipairs(itemsToTarget) do
        if item and item.Parent and not item.Anchored then
            hrp.CFrame = item.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
            task.wait(0.3)
            table.insert(activeItems, item)
        end
    end

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        for _, item in ipairs(activeItems) do
            if item and item.Parent and not item.Anchored then
                item.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(99999, 99999, 99999)
                item.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(99999, 99999, 99999)
            end
        end
    end)
end
